items.t: Goldenwise Group Issues Open Letter Asking Phunware's Board Nine Questions It Must Answer Before the December 17 Annual Meeting
items.sum: Goldenwise Capital Group Limited and its affiliates (together, the "Goldenwise Group"), which have disclosed ownership of approximately 9.2% of the outstanding common stock of Phunware, Inc. (NASDAQ: PHUN) ("Phunware" or the "Company"), today issued an open letter to the Company's Board of Directors and to its fellow stockholders ahead of the Company's December 17, 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockhold

items.t: Phunware Shareholder Goldenwise Group Issues Letter to Board Highlighting Share Price Decline, Director Stock Awards And ATM Stock Program
